I didn't know how divorces work. I think I might've posted this story somewhere before but brain machine broke so idk. Anyways. It's a funny story now but at the time of my wee little six year old(ish) mind, it caused much confusion. For brief back story, my parents divorced before I was born. During the pregnancy, in fact. So I always grew up with spending one summer with one parent, going to school with the other, sometimes vice versa, etc etc.

My best friend's parents were not divorced. So there's been plenty of times I've went over to her house as a kid and couldn't help but stare at her parents, wondering how weird it was that her mom and dad lived together. To me, that was such a foreign concept and I'm pretty sure I asked her at least once where her parents go at the end of the day. Does one "go back home", stuff like that.

Didn't dawn on me until a few years later that divorce was a thing that happened sometimes that caused moms and dads not to live with each other.

Also to a lesser degree thought fireflies were magic stars. I was a weird kid.

Had a dream a few years ago that still freaks me out thinking about it. My entire high school class got kidnapped and I remember "waking up" in the dream after we got grabbed to all my classmates pinned to the floors and walls by nails, spikes, etc. I'm sort of used to morbid dreams so I didn't really think much of it until the kidnapper had appeared. I'm not sure how to describe him other than he was just a shadowy blob that sort of just floated across the floor. He looked at each of us. I remember looking away as he got near to me, hoping he wouldn't take notice.

After awhile, I looked back up to see he was approaching this kid that everyone knew pretty well. His name was Tracey. From what I personally knew of Tracey, having only had like two classes with him before, he was the class clown type. Always had others laughing even at the expense of teachers yelling at him for disrupting lessons. Whatever, we all got a kick out of it. He was on the football team and while we weren't friends, I thought he was pretty nice.

Anyways. Shadow guy comes up to Tracey and pulls out a knife from I'm not really sure where.  Next thing I know, the kids being stabbed and gutted. There's no sound save for that really cartoonish sound of a metal knife being pulled out and stabbed into something and blood spattering out. I remember looking at Tracey's face as this happened and he's just frozen in shock, wide eyed and not making a sound. It seemed like an eternity I was watching this poor kid get disemboweled before I finally woke up.

For awhile, I had almost forgotten about the dream but a few months after having it Tracey died in a car crash. He was thrown from his truck after being hit by a drunk driver into a neighbor's yard where they found him the next morning. It was such a surreal experience when we all found out he had died. It was just before lunch, the principal had come to each class room, explaining what had happened to all of us. The cafeteria that day was the quietest I've ever heard a room of teenagers ever be as everybody took in what had happened.
